name: Pozuelo de Aragón (Spain)
description: Blue field with yellow wavy stripes edged red near the upper and lower edges, charged at the centre with three yellow wells.
history: Municipal flag of Pozuelo de Aragón; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: stripes of yellow and red with a wavy inner edge along the upper edge
stripes of red and yellow with a wavy inner edge along the lower edge
three wells, one above and two below
